title: Space Patrol Luluco
native: 宇宙パトロールルル子
synopsis:
The show takes place in Ogikubo, which is the name of the specially designated area in space in the Milky Way where Earthlings and aliens can live together. Luluco is a female middle school student who lives with her father, and no matter where she is, Luluco is a common, "super normal" girl. As she is living her normal life, one day the mysterious transfer student ΑΩ Nova abruptly appears before her. That meeting will change Luluco's fate.

(Source: Anime News Network)

episodes.title: I'm a Normal Middle School Student
episodes.synopsis: Luluco aims to live a normal life in the abnormal town of Ogikubo, a space immigration zone where humans and aliens coexist, but her normal life comes crashing down with a bang one morning.

episodes.title: A New Transfer Student Arrives!
episodes.synopsis: Things get stranger for Luluco, as the arrival of a transfer student and a new partner shake things up even further.

episodes.title: Battlefield Classroom
episodes.synopsis: The newly formed team of Luluco and Nova head to school to look for Save the World, the alien circulating the Blackhole app.

episodes.title: Into the Sky All Alone
episodes.synopsis: A meteorite comes hurtling towards Ogikubo, and only the Space Patrol trio can prevent Armageddon.

episodes.title: What Should I Do?
episodes.synopsis: Lalaco Godspeed, Luluco's mother and Space Pirate Captain, unveils her grand plan... and it involves Ogikubo?!

episodes.title: That One Part Awakens
episodes.synopsis: Space Pirate Lalaco Godspeed is on the rampage, and only one man can stop her.

episodes.title: The Trap of Fate's Threads
episodes.synopsis: The Space Patrol gang have to find Ogikubo quickly, or they'll have nowhere to go home to! That's when they stumble upon a rather strange planet...

episodes.title: The True Trap

episodes.title: It's All Over
episodes.synopsis: The shocking truth comes to light in truly heart-breaking fashion.

episodes.title: I Was Clueless
